description: Details of a gym. bookable: true: description, address, hours, sites, and bookingUrl (the public booking page). bookable: false: the directory listing (url) and no booking link, whether the gym is claimed or not.

gym.description: Gym identifier: the `gym` value from search_gyms (page slug or Gymmy id).

locale.description: Answer language: fr (default), en, pt, es or de. Pass en when the person writes in English.
